card: Removes trailing newlines from single-line log calls across the codebase via scripted diff, and reformats multi-line log generators (including CTransaction::ToString, wallet descriptor loading errors, and PrintExceptionContinue) to single lines. This prevents log output from being polluted with escaped newline sequences (\x0a) introduced by log sanitization in PR 35833, and eliminates edge cases in trailing newline stripping. PrintExceptionContinue is also updated to use std::source_location and internal thread name getters instead of manual caller arguments. No dependencies.
changed_since_previous: Added two commits: one flattening LoadDescriptorWalletRecords error logging onto a single line, and another reworking PrintExceptionContinue to use std::source_location and single-line logging while removing redundant manual arguments.
evidence: Author notes in PR description: 'After #35833 embedded newlines are escaped and a single trailing one is excluded. It would be clearer to not have a special carve-out here. Also the carve-out may be missing two-or-more trailing newlines.'
Author commit message for PrintExceptionContinue: 'the function formatted the log with newlines, which will be translated into escapes, like: \x0a\x0a************************\x0aEXCEPTION: ...'
problem: Following log sanitization introduced in PR 35833, embedded newlines are escaped as '\x0a', producing cluttered log output when functions format strings across multiple lines (such as PrintExceptionContinue or CTransaction::ToString). Additionally, format strings with explicit trailing newlines falsely suggest newline formatting is supported and require a special carve-out in log sanitization that fails on multiple trailing newlines.

risk.why: Modifications are restricted to log string literals, formatting, and exception logging helpers, with no effect on consensus, validation, or node state.

scope_notes: The primary commit is a mechanical scripted-diff across dozens of files, intentionally excluding a few high-churn files (init.cpp, net.cpp, net_processing.cpp, etc.) to minimize merge conflicts. The remaining commits manually rework CTransaction::ToString, wallet error logging, and PrintExceptionContinue call sites.
summary: Removes trailing newline escape sequences from single-line logging calls across the codebase using a scripted diff, and flattens several multi-line log and string formats into single lines. In particular, it reformats CTransaction::ToString and descriptor wallet loading errors onto single lines, and reworks PrintExceptionContinue to record std::source_location automatically rather than requiring manually passed function or thread names.
